claude_only.name: Which identifier is the authoritative master-system identifier for this AI system, and which system of record issues it?
What trade name and identification reference distinguish this system from other systems supplied by the same provider?
How is the system-level identity kept distinct from the identities of the model artifacts it invokes and the product it is embedded in?
Which external registries hold an identifier for this system, and how are those identifiers reconciled with the master key?
Which version and configuration baseline of the system is currently placed on the market or put into service?
Which component versions — model, software, firmware, prompts, policies — are frozen in this baseline?
How is the integrity of the released baseline demonstrated, and by which build or signing provenance?
When did this baseline take effect and when did it supersede the previous baseline?
Which uses are explicitly excluded, and which reasonably foreseeable misuses have been identified?
Which sectors, environments and affected populations does the declared purpose reach?
Who may change the declared intended purpose, and what re-assessment does such a change trigger?
Under which classification route does the system fall, and which listed use case or harmonisation instrument triggers it?
If a derogation from high-risk classification is claimed, which condition is relied on and what evidence supports it?
Does the system perform profiling of natural persons, which removes any derogation?
Which events require the classification to be reassessed before the system continues in service?
What level of autonomy does the system exercise between human decision points, and where are those points placed?
Does the system adapt after deployment, and through which mechanism — online learning, retrieval updates, or prompt and policy changes?
How is the boundary drawn between inference-derived behaviour and deterministic rule execution inside this system?
Which physical or virtual environments can the system's outputs influence, and through which actuators or downstream integrations?
Which components constitute the system in the released baseline, and which are third-party rather than self-developed?
For each component, what is its supplier, licence and origin of supply?
In which machine-readable bill-of-materials format and specification version is the inventory published?
Which components carry known vulnerabilities or an unsupported end-of-life status at the time of release?
Which model artifacts and versions does the system invoke, and in which role — primary, fallback, guardrail or embedding?
Is each model artifact self-developed, obtained from an upstream provider, or consumed as an external hosted service?
What licence or contractual terms govern use, modification and redistribution of each bound model artifact?
How are upstream model changes detected and propagated into the system baseline?
Which input data streams does the system consume in operation, and which party controls each stream?
How is input data shown to be relevant and sufficiently representative in view of the intended purpose?
Which input fields contain personal or special-category data, and what lawful basis and safeguards apply?
What input data specifications are published to deployers so that operation remains inside the validated envelope?
Which legal entity holds each operator role for this system in each market where it is supplied?
Which named role is accountable for placing the system on the market and for keeping technical documentation current?
Which internal functions — design, development, test and evaluation, deployment, operation, human oversight, governance — are staffed for this system?
Under which conditions does a deployer or distributor assume provider obligations for this system?
Which lifecycle stage is the system in — design and development, data handling, verification and validation, deployment, or operation and monitoring?
What is the current market or service status: on the market, in service, no longer placed on the market, recalled, or withdrawn?
Who authorised each recorded state transition, and on what evidence?
Which gate criteria must be satisfied before the system may move to the next stage?
Does the proposed change constitute a substantial modification that was not foreseen in the initial conformity assessment?
Which changes are covered by a pre-authorised change plan, and under which modification protocol are they executed?
What impact assessment supports the change, and which tests must pass before the new baseline is released?
What sequence of planned changes over the system lifetime is recorded in the technical documentation?
In which environments and physical or cloud locations is the system deployed, and where is inference processing actually performed?
Which hardware and computational resources does the system require to operate as intended?
Through which interfaces does the system interact with other software, hardware or AI systems that are not part of it?
In which jurisdictions is the system placed on the market or put into service, and which regulatory regime governs each?
Which events does the system automatically record over its lifetime, and at what granularity?
How are event time and record or ingestion time captured and distinguished in each log entry?
Who may read operational logs, under which controls, and for which purposes?
How is log integrity protected against alteration or deletion during the retention period?
What is the current operational state of each deployed instance — active, degraded, suspended or offline?
Which runtime indicators are observed continuously to detect deviation from validated behaviour?
Which runtime conditions trigger automatic containment, fallback or shutdown of the system?
Which oversight measures are built into the system by the provider and which must be implemented by the deployer?
Which natural persons are assigned oversight duties, and what competence, training and authority do they hold?
How can an overseer interrupt, override or reverse a system output, and within what time window?
How is automation bias in overseers detected and mitigated for this system?
What levels of accuracy and robustness are declared to deployers, and under which conditions do they hold?
What are the known limitations, degradation conditions and reasonably foreseeable unintended outcomes?
How often are metrics recomputed in operation, and against which reference period and dataset?
Which validation and testing procedures were executed, on which datasets, and with what results?
Which test logs and reports are retained, dated and countersigned by the responsible persons?
How are evaluation datasets shown to be separated from training data and fit for the evaluation claim made?
Which evaluation results failed acceptance criteria, and how were those failures dispositioned before release?
Which cybersecurity measures protect the system against unauthorised access, model theft and infrastructure compromise?
Which adversarial attack classes are in the threat model for this system, and which residual exposures are accepted?
How is resilience against each in-scope attack class tested, and with what measured result?
What is the detection and response path for a security event that alters AI-specific behaviour rather than infrastructure?
Which conformity assessment procedure was followed, and was a notified body involved?
Which declaration of conformity and marking has been issued, by which entity, and for which system version?
Which harmonised standards or common specifications were applied, and where an alternative solution was adopted, how is equivalence justified?
When does the certificate expire and which events force re-assessment before that date?
Which public database entry represents this system, and what is its resolvable identifier or URL?
Which registration fields must be supplied and kept up to date by the provider, and which by the deployer?
Which registration data are publicly visible and which are restricted to authorities?
When was the registration entry created and last updated, and what triggers a mandatory update?
How and at what moment are natural persons informed that they are interacting with an AI system?
How is synthetic output marked in a machine-readable format that is detectable as artificially generated or manipulated?
Which disclosure exemptions are relied on for this system, and what safeguards replace disclosure?
How is the disclosure made accessible to persons with disabilities and to persons subject to automated decisions?
How is the risk management system established, documented and maintained as a continuous iterative process across the lifetime of the system?
How is each identified risk characterised in terms of probability of occurrence and severity of harm?
Which residual risks are accepted, by which role, and on what documented grounds?
What cadence governs risk review, and which events force an out-of-cycle reassessment?
Is an impact assessment on fundamental rights required for this deployment, and what must it cover?
How does the AI impact assessment relate to and reuse the data protection impact assessment for the same processing?
Which categories of persons or groups are likely to be affected, and how were they or their representatives consulted?
What summary of findings is submitted to the competent authority, and where is the full assessment retained?
What does the post-market monitoring plan require to be collected, analysed and reviewed over the system's lifetime?
Which data do deployers supply to the provider, through which channel and at what frequency?
Which thresholds in monitored data trigger investigation or corrective action?
How is monitoring integrated with pre-existing sectoral post-market systems without duplicating obligations?
What qualifies as a serious incident for this system, and by which detection route is it recognised?
By which deadline must the incident be reported after awareness, and which deadline class applies?
To which market surveillance authority is the report addressed, and who signs it on behalf of which operator?
What investigation, risk assessment and corrective action follow the report, and how is the outcome recorded?
How long are logs, technical documentation and evaluation evidence retained, and under which legal or contractual basis?
What steps decommission the system, including withdrawal from market, deployer notification and disposition of data and models?
How are personal data in logs, caches and derived stores deleted or minimised while preserving audit capability?
What terminal status is recorded for a withdrawn system, and where does that record remain discoverable?

grok_only.name: Which definition of AI system is adopted for this instance and how is it distinguished from ordinary rule-executing software?
Does this instance infer how to generate predictions, content, recommendations or decisions from inputs in a way that can influence physical or virtual environments?
Which definitional conflicts between OECD, EU, ISO/IEC 22989 and NIST AI RMF 1.0 are recorded for this instance rather than claimed as conformance?
What degree of autonomy is delegated to this system after humans have set its operating envelope?
Does the system exhibit post-deployment adaptiveness, continuous learning, or other behaviour change during use?
Who originates explicit or implicit objectives, and can the system form sub-objectives or set objectives for other systems?
What is the authoritative master-system identifier, and which global IRI or Dimension UUID is used if the master identifier is absent?
Under whose name or trademark is the system placed on the market or put into service, and how does that party relate to any third-party developer?
How does this version relate to previous versions, and which software or firmware versions are required to run it?
What reasonably foreseeable misuse is documented, including misuse arising from interaction with other AI systems?
In which markets, jurisdictions, operational locations or publicly accessible spaces will the system operate or will its outputs be used?
Who uses the system, who is impacted, and what human-rights, wellbeing, labour or environmental effects are in scope?
In which industrial sector, business function and technical-maturity setting is the system deployed?
What tasks does the system perform, does it combine tasks into a composite or autonomous control system, and what action does it take on the environment?
Does this socio-technical profile justify treating the system as in-scope for heightened governance even if no high-risk legal class applies?
Has the system been screened against prohibited AI practices, and is any residual prohibited use blocked as an exception?
Is the system classified as high-risk under product-safety or Annex III rules, or has a documented not-high-risk assessment been registered?
Do chatbot, generative, emotion-recognition or other transparency obligations apply to this system independently of high-risk status?
When was the current risk class decided, and when must it be re-evaluated if intended purpose or capabilities change?
Is this record a general-purpose AI system, a single-purpose system, or a downstream system that integrates a GPAI model?
Which general-purpose or other models are integrated, and is integration vertical or contractual with another entity?
Is any integrated model still in research, development or prototyping before being placed on the market, and therefore outside GPAI-model placing rules?
Which model artifacts and other software or hardware components constitute this AI system, and which are explicitly not part of it?
How do software components build on or feed into each other, and what computational resources were used to develop, train, test and validate?
In which forms is the system placed on the market or put into service, such as embedded packages, downloads or APIs?
What training, validation, testing and input data requirements apply at system level, including fitness for intended purpose?
What is the provenance and collection method of data and expert input used to build and operate the system?
What personal-data, special-category or biometric constraints apply to system inputs, logs and outputs?
Which importers, distributors, authorised representatives, product manufacturers and downstream providers are in the value chain of this system?
Has any deployer or other operator become a provider by placing the system under its own name, making a substantial modification, or changing intended purpose?
Does the system expose one or more agent actors, and which sibling agent records are linked without duplicating agent semantics?
Who is the provider and who is the deployer, and is personal non-professional use excluded from deployer duties?
Who owns the governed system record and is accountable for its responsible provision or use inside the adopting organisation?
What measures support AI literacy of providers, deployers and affected persons for this system?
What human oversight mode is implemented, and at which lifecycle stages can humans supervise, override or halt the system?
What technical measures enable deployers to interpret outputs and use them appropriately?
What happens if the designated human overseer is unavailable, overloaded or in disagreement with the system output?
What is the current lifecycle stage and operating status of this AI system?
When was the system placed on the market or put into service, and is it in a sandbox or real-world testing regime that is not placing on the market?
Have design, deployment or validation stages been re-entered for fixes, updates or re-evaluation, and under what process?
Is a proposed or completed change a predetermined change within the assessed envelope, or a substantial modification requiring new assessment?
If the system learns in operation, what automated testing and change-control keep later versions inside certified behaviour?
When did the modification occur in the world, when was it observed, and when was conformity re-assessed?
Is the system being recalled, withdrawn, disabled, replaced or retired, and what is the trigger?
What data, model artifacts, logs and access paths are disposed of or retained at retirement?
Which post-exit duties remain, including documentation keeping, incident linkage and residual human-rights or safety monitoring?
What reasonably foreseeable risks to health, safety, fundamental rights and discrimination are identified for the intended purpose, and how are they treated?
What AI system impact assessment or fundamental-rights impact assessment has been performed, at which lifecycle stages, and with which stakeholder input?
Which serious-incident or hazard reports name this system, without storing the incident case in this record?
What robustness, cybersecurity and resilience measures protect the system against perturbations, data poisoning, model theft or availability attacks?
How is harmful bias measured and managed for persons or groups on whom the system is intended to be used?
What verification and validation procedures, test data characteristics, test logs and signed reports demonstrate that the system meets its requirements?
Does current technical documentation contain the Annex IV elements applicable to this system, including post-market monitoring plans?
What events are automatically logged, for how long, and can logs trace operation sufficiently for post-market monitoring and oversight?
What conformity assessment procedure was applied, and where are the EU declaration of conformity, CE marking and certificates?
Who may access technical documentation, logs, operating interfaces and impact assessments, under which scopes and with which audit trail?
How long are documentation, logs and residual operational data retained, and how are they deleted or put into escrow if the provider ceases activity?
Which external standards and legal instruments is this system aligned to, and where do those instruments conflict so that conformance is not claimed?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
